verdict.rationale: Outbound webhooks are a fair question for a workflow orchestration platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Signals, Queries and Updates are inbound messages to Workflows, Activities that call other services are developer building blocks, and metrics streaming to observability tools is an adjacent feature; none of these is an event-subscription webhook mechanism.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
